notes: The mounted pressure-ENGAGEMENT court: Full/Focused/Pressure x FUSE writers 1/4/8/16/32 at pool-16 on build-artifacts, pool-8 at writers 16, and the ci-cache/container-layers/generated-assets/scientific-outputs families at writers 16 pool-16. The write phase is 2 s of sustained DISTINCT 1 MiB structured writes per (writer, round) (the engagement floor verified by the phase probe: 1.0-1.5 s does not engage, 2.0 s+ does). The pressure state machine's causal witnesses (enter/leave events, time pressured, rANS skips, deferred bytes, peak debt, debt-cap engagements) come from the daemon's --stats-file dump. The settle (optimize + gc) is bounded by a 150 s per-cell budget (the background search is ~8-50 ms/extent single-threaded; the 16/32-writer cells' 17-25k extents exceed the budget, so their settled rows are PARTIAL-settlement states — the deterministic convergence authority is the 12C-1-2 direct-engine court, sealed pressure-deferral-probe-*/). Court-found defects fixed in this release: the pool runtime-mutex deadlock, the backpressure starvation/lost-wakeup, the admission TOCTOU, the overlay-only-inode base_chunk_at crash, and the over-depth chain repair ordering (see CHANGELOG v0.7.17 and docs/performance/adaptive-budget.md 12C-1-3).
